output.reason: The change says all of Traefik v2 is end-of-life: v2.11 lost support on 2026-09-07 and older v2 minors ended earlier. So the exposed environments are those running a v2 release today. [ev-525d11df6567] backs the support-window policy (the last minor after a new major gets 2 years), but its excerpt is cut off and does not state the v2 dates itself. The version range in the proposal is right, but it uses product-version, which is for another product's version. The version of this product that an environment runs is expressed by edge-from-version.

correction.statement: Traefik Proxy v2 (last minor v2.11) is end-of-life since 2026-09-07 and gets no more security fixes. Environments running any v2 release (>=2.0.0, <3.0.0) are exposed and should plan the move to v3.
